diff --git a/durability.go b/durability.go
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..5e839301
--- /dev/null
+++ b/durability.go
@@ -0,0 +1,431 @@
+// Copyright 2026 The LevelDB-Go and Pebble Authors. All rights reserved. Use
+// of this source code is governed by a BSD-style license that can be found in
+// the LICENSE file.
+
+package pebble
+
+import (
+	"container/heap"
+	"context"
+	"sync"
+	"sync/atomic"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/errors"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/internal/base"
+)
+
+var (
+	// ErrDurabilityJobExpired is returned by WaitForJobDurability when the job
+	// ID is older than the bounded window of retained durability results. Use
+	// errors.Is(err, ErrDurabilityJobExpired) to check for this error.
+	ErrDurabilityJobExpired = errors.New("pebble: durability job expired")
+	// ErrDurabilityJobUnknown is returned by WaitForJobDurability when the job
+	// ID does not correspond to any BatchDurable event. Use errors.Is(err,
+	// ErrDurabilityJobUnknown) to check for this error.
+	ErrDurabilityJobUnknown = errors.New("pebble: unknown durability job")
+	// ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions is delivered on the channel returned by
+	// DurabilityNotify when the number of outstanding subscriptions exceeds
+	// the limit.
+	ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions = errors.New("pebble: too many outstanding durability subscriptions")
+)
+
+const (
+	// durabilityJobRetention is the number of most recent BatchDurable job
+	// results retained for WaitForJobDurability.
+	durabilityJobRetention = 1024
+	// maxDurabilitySubscriptions bounds the number of outstanding
+	// DurabilityNotify subscriptions.
+	maxDurabilitySubscriptions = 4096
+)
+
+// DurabilityStats is a snapshot of the DB's batch durability tracking state.
+type DurabilityStats struct {
+	// HighestDurableSeqNum is the highest sequence number known to be durable
+	// in the WAL as a result of a Sync commit.
+	HighestDurableSeqNum base.SeqNum
+	// FirstErr is the first WAL sync error observed by a Sync commit.
+	FirstErr error
+	// PendingWaiters is the number of goroutines currently blocked in one of
+	// the WaitForDurability* APIs.
+	PendingWaiters int64
+	// TotalDurableCommits is the number of Sync commits that became durable.
+	TotalDurableCommits uint64
+	// TotalFailedCommits is the number of Sync commits that failed.
+	TotalFailedCommits uint64
+	// CumulativeSyncDuration is the cumulative WAL sync phase duration of
+	// successful Sync commits.
+	CumulativeSyncDuration time.Duration
+	// MaxSyncDuration is the maximum WAL sync phase duration of a successful
+	// Sync commit.
+	MaxSyncDuration time.Duration
+}
+
+// durabilityWaiter is a request to be notified when a sequence number becomes
+// durable (or durability can no longer be achieved).
+type durabilityWaiter struct {
+	seqNum base.SeqNum
+	// ch is buffered with capacity 1; exactly one value is sent.
+	ch chan error
+	// subscription is true for DurabilityNotify waiters, which count against
+	// maxDurabilitySubscriptions.
+	subscription bool
+	// index is the position within durabilityWaiterHeap, or -1 if the waiter
+	// has been removed.
+	index int
+}
+
+type durabilityWaiterHeap []*durabilityWaiter
+
+func (h durabilityWaiterHeap) Len() int           { return len(h) }
+func (h durabilityWaiterHeap) Less(i, j int) bool { return h[i].seqNum < h[j].seqNum }
+func (h durabilityWaiterHeap) Swap(i, j int) {
+	h[i], h[j] = h[j], h[i]
+	h[i].index = i
+	h[j].index = j
+}
+func (h *durabilityWaiterHeap) Push(x any) {
+	w := x.(*durabilityWaiter)
+	w.index = len(*h)
+	*h = append(*h, w)
+}
+func (h *durabilityWaiterHeap) Pop() any {
+	old := *h
+	n := len(old)
+	w := old[n-1]
+	old[n-1] = nil
+	w.index = -1
+	*h = old[:n-1]
+	return w
+}
+
+// durabilityTracker tracks the highest durable sequence number resulting from
+// Sync commits, and the goroutines and subscriptions waiting on it.
+type durabilityTracker struct {
+	pendingWaiters atomic.Int64
+
+	// Metrics accumulated only when EventListener.BatchDurable is configured.
+	metrics struct {
+		count    atomic.Uint64
+		duration atomic.Int64
+	}
+
+	mu struct {
+		sync.Mutex
+		durable  base.SeqNum
+		firstErr error
+		closed   bool
+		waiters  durabilityWaiterHeap
+		numSubs  int
+
+		totalDurable uint64
+		totalFailed  uint64
+		cumSync      time.Duration
+		maxSync      time.Duration
+
+		// jobs retains the results of the most recent durabilityJobRetention
+		// jobs. jobRing holds the same jobs in insertion order.
+		jobs       map[int]error
+		jobRing    [durabilityJobRetention]int
+		jobRingPos int
+		// maxEvictedJobID is the largest job ID evicted from jobs.
+		maxEvictedJobID int
+	}
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) init() {
+	t.mu.jobs = make(map[int]error)
+}
+
+// record records the outcome of a Sync commit whose last sequence number is
+// lastSeqNum. jobID is zero if no job ID was assigned.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) record(
+	jobID int, lastSeqNum base.SeqNum, err error, latchErr bool, syncDur time.Duration,
+) {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	if jobID != 0 {
+		t.recordJobLocked(jobID, err)
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		t.mu.totalFailed++
+		if latchErr && t.mu.firstErr == nil {
+			t.mu.firstErr = err
+			// Durability can no longer be guaranteed for any sequence number
+			// above the durable sequence number.
+			t.failAllLocked(err)
+		}
+		return
+	}
+	t.mu.totalDurable++
+	t.mu.cumSync += syncDur
+	t.mu.maxSync = max(t.mu.maxSync, syncDur)
+	if lastSeqNum <= t.mu.durable {
+		return
+	}
+	t.mu.durable = lastSeqNum
+	for len(t.mu.waiters) > 0 && t.mu.waiters[0].seqNum <= lastSeqNum {
+		t.deliverLocked(heap.Pop(&t.mu.waiters).(*durabilityWaiter), nil)
+	}
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) recordJobLocked(jobID int, err error) {
+	if old := t.mu.jobRing[t.mu.jobRingPos]; old != 0 {
+		delete(t.mu.jobs, old)
+		t.mu.maxEvictedJobID = max(t.mu.maxEvictedJobID, old)
+	}
+	t.mu.jobRing[t.mu.jobRingPos] = jobID
+	t.mu.jobRingPos = (t.mu.jobRingPos + 1) % durabilityJobRetention
+	t.mu.jobs[jobID] = err
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) deliverLocked(w *durabilityWaiter, err error) {
+	if w.subscription {
+		t.mu.numSubs--
+	}
+	w.ch <- err
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) failAllLocked(err error) {
+	for len(t.mu.waiters) > 0 {
+		t.deliverLocked(heap.Pop(&t.mu.waiters).(*durabilityWaiter), err)
+	}
+}
+
+// close unblocks all waiters with ErrClosed and causes future waits on
+// non-durable sequence numbers to fail.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) close() {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	t.mu.closed = true
+	t.failAllLocked(ErrClosed)
+}
+
+// stateLocked returns the result for a wait on seqNum if it can be determined
+// without blocking.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) stateLocked(seqNum base.SeqNum) (done bool, err error) {
+	switch {
+	case seqNum <= t.mu.durable:
+		return true, nil
+	case t.mu.firstErr != nil:
+		return true, t.mu.firstErr
+	case t.mu.closed:
+		return true, ErrClosed
+	}
+	return false, nil
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) wait(ctx context.Context, seqNum base.SeqNum) error {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	if done, err := t.stateLocked(seqNum); done {
+		t.mu.Unlock()
+		return err
+	}
+	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+		t.mu.Unlock()
+		return err
+	}
+	w := &durabilityWaiter{seqNum: seqNum, ch: make(chan error, 1)}
+	heap.Push(&t.mu.waiters, w)
+	t.mu.Unlock()
+
+	t.pendingWaiters.Add(1)
+	defer t.pendingWaiters.Add(-1)
+	select {
+	case err := <-w.ch:
+		return err
+	case <-ctx.Done():
+		t.mu.Lock()
+		defer t.mu.Unlock()
+		if w.index < 0 {
+			// The waiter was concurrently delivered a result, which takes
+			// precedence over the context error.
+			return <-w.ch
+		}
+		heap.Remove(&t.mu.waiters, w.index)
+		w.index = -1
+		return ctx.Err()
+	}
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) notify(seqNum base.SeqNum) <-chan error {
+	ch := make(chan error, 1)
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	if done, err := t.stateLocked(seqNum); done {
+		ch <- err
+		return ch
+	}
+	if t.mu.numSubs >= maxDurabilitySubscriptions {
+		ch <- ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions
+		return ch
+	}
+	t.mu.numSubs++
+	heap.Push(&t.mu.waiters, &durabilityWaiter{seqNum: seqNum, ch: ch, subscription: true})
+	return ch
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) jobResult(jobID int) error {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	if jobID > 0 {
+		if err, ok := t.mu.jobs[jobID]; ok {
+			return err
+		}
+		if jobID <= t.mu.maxEvictedJobID {
+			return errors.Wrapf(ErrDurabilityJobExpired, "job %d", errors.Safe(jobID))
+		}
+	}
+	return errors.Wrapf(ErrDurabilityJobUnknown, "job %d", errors.Safe(jobID))
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) state() (base.SeqNum, error) {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	return t.mu.durable, t.mu.firstErr
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) stats() DurabilityStats {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	return DurabilityStats{
+		HighestDurableSeqNum:   t.mu.durable,
+		FirstErr:               t.mu.firstErr,
+		PendingWaiters:         t.pendingWaiters.Load(),
+		TotalDurableCommits:    t.mu.totalDurable,
+		TotalFailedCommits:     t.mu.totalFailed,
+		CumulativeSyncDuration: t.mu.cumSync,
+		MaxSyncDuration:        t.mu.maxSync,
+	}
+}
+
+// onBatchDurable is invoked exactly once per Sync commit of a non-empty batch,
+// after the WAL sync completes (or the commit fails).
+func (d *DB) onBatchDurable(b *Batch, err error) {
+	seqNum := b.SeqNum()
+	count := b.Count()
+	var lastSeqNum base.SeqNum
+	if count > 0 && count != invalidBatchCount {
+		lastSeqNum = seqNum + base.SeqNum(count) - 1
+	}
+	applyDur, syncDur := b.durability.applyDuration, b.durability.syncDuration
+	if err == nil {
+		// Durations are measured wall-clock time and are guaranteed positive
+		// for successful commits, even with a coarse clock.
+		applyDur = max(applyDur, time.Nanosecond)
+		syncDur = max(syncDur, time.Nanosecond)
+	}
+	// An invalid batch is a usage error that does not compromise the
+	// durability of other writes.
+	latchErr := !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidBatch)
+
+	var jobID int
+	if d.batchDurableEnabled {
+		jobID = int(d.newJobID())
+	}
+	d.durability.record(jobID, lastSeqNum, err, latchErr, syncDur)
+	if !d.batchDurableEnabled {
+		return
+	}
+	if err == nil {
+		d.durability.metrics.count.Add(1)
+		d.durability.metrics.duration.Add(int64(syncDur))
+	}
+	d.opts.EventListener.BatchDurable(BatchDurableInfo{
+		JobID:         jobID,
+		SeqNum:        seqNum,
+		Err:           err,
+		ApplyDuration: applyDur,
+		SyncDuration:  syncDur,
+		CorrelationID: b.durability.correlationID,
+		BatchSize:     len(b.data),
+		KeyCount:      count,
+	})
+}
+
+// WaitForDurability blocks until the specified sequence number is durable in
+// the WAL as a result of a Sync commit. It returns an error if a WAL sync
+// fails or the DB is closed before the sequence number becomes durable. A
+// zero sequence number is trivially durable. If the WAL is disabled,
+// WaitForDurability returns nil immediately.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurability(seqNum base.SeqNum) error {
+	return d.WaitForDurabilityContext(context.Background(), seqNum)
+}
+
+// WaitForDurabilityContext is like WaitForDurability, but additionally
+// returns ctx.Err() if the context is done before the outcome is known.
+// Durability and close errors take precedence over context errors.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx context.Context, seqNum base.SeqNum) error {
+	if d.opts.DisableWAL {
+		return nil
+	}
+	return d.durability.wait(ctx, seqNum)
+}
+
+// WaitForDurabilityBatch blocks until all of the specified sequence numbers
+// are durable. It returns nil if seqNums is empty.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityBatch(seqNums []base.SeqNum) error {
+	return d.WaitForDurabilityBatchContext(context.Background(), seqNums)
+}
+
+// WaitForDurabilityBatchContext is like WaitForDurabilityBatch, but
+// additionally returns ctx.Err() if the context is done before the outcome is
+// known.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityBatchContext(ctx context.Context, seqNums []base.SeqNum) error {
+	if len(seqNums) == 0 || d.opts.DisableWAL {
+		return nil
+	}
+	// The durable sequence number only ratchets upwards, so waiting for the
+	// maximum suffices.
+	var maxSeqNum base.SeqNum
+	for _, s := range seqNums {
+		maxSeqNum = max(maxSeqNum, s)
+	}
+	return d.durability.wait(ctx, maxSeqNum)
+}
+
+// WaitForJobDurability returns the durability outcome of the Sync commit
+// identified by the BatchDurableInfo.JobID. Only the most recent jobs are
+// retained; older jobs return an error wrapping ErrDurabilityJobExpired. Job
+// IDs that never corresponded to a BatchDurable event (including zero) return
+// an error wrapping ErrDurabilityJobUnknown.
+func (d *DB) WaitForJobDurability(jobID int) error {
+	return d.WaitForJobDurabilityContext(context.Background(), jobID)
+}
+
+// WaitForJobDurabilityContext is like WaitForJobDurability, but accepts a
+// context. Since a job ID is only observable once its BatchDurable event has
+// fired, the outcome is always known immediately and takes precedence over
+// the context.
+func (d *DB) WaitForJobDurabilityContext(ctx context.Context, jobID int) error {
+	if d.opts.DisableWAL {
+		return nil
+	}
+	return d.durability.jobResult(jobID)
+}
+
+// DurableState returns the highest sequence number known to be durable and
+// the first WAL sync error observed, if any.
+func (d *DB) DurableState() (base.SeqNum, error) {
+	return d.durability.state()
+}
+
+// DurabilityNotify returns a channel that receives exactly one value: nil once
+// seqNum is durable, or a non-nil error if a WAL sync fails or the DB is
+// closed first. The number of outstanding subscriptions is bounded; once the
+// bound is reached, the returned channel immediately delivers
+// ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions. If the WAL is disabled, the channel
+// immediately delivers nil.
+func (d *DB) DurabilityNotify(seqNum base.SeqNum) <-chan error {
+	if d.opts.DisableWAL {
+		ch := make(chan error, 1)
+		ch <- nil
+		return ch
+	}
+	return d.durability.notify(seqNum)
+}
+
+// DurabilityStats returns a snapshot of the DB's durability tracking state.
+func (d *DB) DurabilityStats() DurabilityStats {
+	return d.durability.stats()
+}

--- /dev/null
+++ b/durability_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,241 @@
+// Copyright 2026 The LevelDB-Go and Pebble Authors. All rights reserved. Use
+// of this source code is governed by a BSD-style license that can be found in
+// the LICENSE file.
+
+package pebble
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"strings"
+	"sync"
+	"sync/atomic"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/errors"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/internal/base"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/vfs"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/vfs/errorfs"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+type batchDurableRecorder struct {
+	mu    sync.Mutex
+	infos []BatchDurableInfo
+}
+
+func (r *batchDurableRecorder) record(info BatchDurableInfo) {
+	r.mu.Lock()
+	defer r.mu.Unlock()
+	r.infos = append(r.infos, info)
+}
+
+func (r *batchDurableRecorder) get() []BatchDurableInfo {
+	r.mu.Lock()
+	defer r.mu.Unlock()
+	return append([]BatchDurableInfo(nil), r.infos...)
+}
+
+func openDurabilityTestDB(t *testing.T, opts *Options) *DB {
+	if opts.FS == nil {
+		opts.FS = vfs.NewMem()
+	}
+	d, err := Open("", opts)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	return d
+}
+
+func TestBatchDurableEvent(t *testing.T) {
+	var rec batchDurableRecorder
+	d := openDurabilityTestDB(t, &Options{
+		EventListener: &EventListener{BatchDurable: rec.record},
+	})
+	defer func() { require.NoError(t, d.Close()) }()
+
+	require.Equal(t, DurabilityStats{}, d.DurabilityStats())
+
+	// Non-sync commits never fire the event.
+	require.NoError(t, d.Set([]byte("a"), []byte("1"), NoSync))
+	require.Empty(t, rec.get())
+
+	b := d.NewBatch()
+	require.NoError(t, b.Set([]byte("b"), []byte("2"), nil))
+	require.NoError(t, b.Set([]byte("c"), []byte("3"), nil))
+	size := len(b.Repr())
+	require.NoError(t, b.Commit(&WriteOptions{Sync: true, CommitCorrelationID: 42}))
+	seq := b.SeqNum()
+	require.NoError(t, b.Close())
+
+	infos := rec.get()
+	require.Len(t, infos, 1)
+	info := infos[0]
+	require.NoError(t, info.Err)
+	require.NotZero(t, info.JobID)
+	require.Equal(t, seq, info.SeqNum)
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(42), info.CorrelationID)
+	require.Equal(t, size, info.BatchSize)
+	require.Equal(t, uint32(2), info.KeyCount)
+	require.Positive(t, info.ApplyDuration)
+	require.Positive(t, info.SyncDuration)

+	durable, err := d.DurableState()
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, seq+1, durable)
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurability(seq))
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurability(0))
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurabilityBatch(nil))
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurabilityBatch([]base.SeqNum{seq, seq + 1}))
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForJobDurability(info.JobID))
+	require.NoError(t, <-d.DurabilityNotify(seq))

+	err = d.WaitForJobDurability(0)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrDurabilityJobUnknown)

+	require.ErrorIs(t, d.WaitForJobDurability(1<<30), ErrDurabilityJobUnknown)

+	stats := d.DurabilityStats()
+	require.Equal(t, seq+1, stats.HighestDurableSeqNum)
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(1), stats.TotalDurableCommits)
+	require.Zero(t, stats.TotalFailedCommits)
+	require.Positive(t, stats.CumulativeSyncDuration)
+	require.Equal(t, stats.CumulativeSyncDuration, stats.MaxSyncDuration)

+	m := d.Metrics()
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(1), m.DurableCommitCount)
+	require.Equal(t, stats.CumulativeSyncDuration, m.DurableCommitDuration)

+	require.NoError(t, d.ApplyNoSyncWait(b, Sync))
+	require.NoError(t, b.SyncWait())
+	require.NoError(t, b.SyncWait())
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurability(b.SeqNum()))
+	require.NoError(t, b.Close())
+	require.Len(t, rec.get(), 2)
+}

+func TestDurabilityWaitersWithoutListener(t *testing.T) {
+	d := openDurabilityTestDB(t, &Options{})
+	require.False(t, d.batchDurableEnabled)
+
+	target := d.mu.versions.logSeqNum.Load()
+	notifyCh := d.DurabilityNotify(target)
+	errCh := make(chan error, 1)
+	go func() { errCh <- d.WaitForDurability(target) }()
+	require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
+		return d.DurabilityStats().PendingWaiters == 1
+	}, 10*time.Second, time.Millisecond)
+
+	// A context-cancelled wait returns the context error.
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	cancel()
+	require.ErrorIs(t, d.WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx, target), context.Canceled)
+
+	require.NoError(t, d.Set([]byte("a"), []byte("1"), Sync))
+	require.NoError(t, <-errCh)
+	require.NoError(t, <-notifyCh)
+	require.Zero(t, d.DurabilityStats().PendingWaiters)
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(1), d.DurabilityStats().TotalDurableCommits)
+	require.Zero(t, d.Metrics().DurableCommitCount)
+
+	// Waiters unblock with an error on close.
+	notifyCh = d.DurabilityNotify(target + 100)
+	go func() { errCh <- d.WaitForDurability(target + 100) }()
+	require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
+		return d.DurabilityStats().PendingWaiters == 1
+	}, 10*time.Second, time.Millisecond)
+	require.NoError(t, d.Close())
+	require.ErrorIs(t, <-errCh, ErrClosed)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, <-notifyCh, ErrClosed)
+	// Close errors take precedence over context errors.
+	require.ErrorIs(t, d.WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx, target+100), ErrClosed)
+}

+func TestBatchDurableSyncError(t *testing.T) {
+	var failSync atomic.Bool
+	fs := errorfs.Wrap(vfs.NewMem(), errorfs.InjectorFunc(func(op errorfs.Op) error {
+		if failSync.Load() && strings.HasSuffix(op.Path, ".log") &&
+			(op.Kind == errorfs.OpFileSync || op.Kind == errorfs.OpFileSyncData) {
+			return errorfs.ErrInjected
+		}
+		return nil
+	}))
+	var rec batchDurableRecorder
+	var fatals atomic.Int32
+	d := openDurabilityTestDB(t, &Options{
+		FS:            fs,
+		Logger:        &mockLogger{fatalFunc: func(string, ...interface{}) { fatals.Add(1) }},
+		EventListener: &EventListener{BatchDurable: rec.record},
+	})
+	target := d.mu.versions.logSeqNum.Load() + 1000
+	notifyCh := d.DurabilityNotify(target)
+
+	failSync.Store(true)
+	require.NoError(t, d.Set([]byte("a"), []byte("1"), Sync))
+	infos := rec.get()
+	require.Len(t, infos, 1)
+	require.Error(t, infos[0].Err)
+	require.Positive(t, fatals.Load())
+
+	_, err := d.DurableState()
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	require.Error(t, <-notifyCh)
+	require.Error(t, d.WaitForDurability(target))
+	require.True(t, errors.Is(d.WaitForJobDurability(infos[0].JobID), errorfs.ErrInjected))
+	stats := d.DurabilityStats()
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(1), stats.TotalFailedCommits)
+	require.Error(t, stats.FirstErr)
+	require.Zero(t, d.Metrics().DurableCommitCount)
+	_ = d.Close()
+}

+// BatchDurableInfo contains the info for a batch durable event, which is
+// emitted once per Sync commit after the WAL sync completes (or fails).
+type BatchDurableInfo struct {
+	// JobID is the ID of the job associated with the commit. It may be passed
+	// to DB.WaitForJobDurability.
+	JobID int
+	// SeqNum is the sequence number of the batch.
+	SeqNum base.SeqNum
+	// Err is the error, if any, that prevented the batch from becoming
+	// durable.
+	Err error
+	// ApplyDuration is the time spent applying the batch to the memtable.
+	ApplyDuration time.Duration
+	// SyncDuration is the time spent waiting for the WAL sync, measured from
+	// when the batch was written to the WAL.
+	SyncDuration time.Duration
+	// CorrelationID is the WriteOptions.CommitCorrelationID of the commit.
+	CorrelationID uint64
+	// BatchSize is the size of the encoded batch in bytes.
+	BatchSize int
+	// KeyCount is the number of entries in the batch.
+	KeyCount uint32
+}

+func (i BatchDurableInfo) String() string {
+	return redact.StringWithoutMarkers(i)
+}
+
+// SafeFormat implements redact.SafeFormatter.
+func (i BatchDurableInfo) SafeFormat(w redact.SafePrinter, _ rune) {
+	if i.Err != nil {
+		w.Printf("[JOB %d] batch durable error: seqnum %d: %s",
+			redact.Safe(i.JobID), redact.Safe(i.SeqNum), i.Err)
+		return
+	}
+	w.Printf("[JOB %d] batch durable: seqnum %d, %d keys, %d bytes, apply %.3fs, sync %.3fs",
+		redact.Safe(i.JobID), redact.Safe(i.SeqNum), redact.Safe(i.KeyCount),
+		redact.Safe(i.BatchSize), redact.Safe(i.ApplyDuration.Seconds()),
+		redact.Safe(i.SyncDuration.Seconds()))
+}

+// noopBatchDurable is the default EventListener.BatchDurable. It is
+// distinguished from user-provided callbacks so that the DB can avoid the
